```python
import pixeltable as pxt

# Get the films table
table = pxt.get_table('films')

# Filter rows where year > 1990, select title and revenue columns, and materialize
rows = table.where(table.year > 1990).select(table.title, table.revenue).collect()

# Iterate through materialized rows
for row in rows:
    print(row)
```
